# antigravity.google documentation — Docs — Cli

> 36 page(s) of antigravity.google documentation — Docs under Cli. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Cli

- [Antigravity CLI Overview](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/overview/): The Antigravity CLI is the lightweight Terminal User Interface (TUI) surface of Antigravity.
- [Getting Started with Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/getting-started/): Welcome to Antigravity CLI!
- [Installation & auth](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/install/): Install Antigravity CLI, configure enterprise requirements, and establish secure authenticated sessions.
- [Antigravity CLI Tutorial](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/tutorial/): Learn how to launch Antigravity CLI, collaborate with an autonomous local agent, review generated files, and execute terminal test commands.
- [Using AGY CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/using/): Antigravity CLI provides a flexible configuration system to customize workspace behavior, safety restrictions, editor preferences, visual style, and performance.
- [Antigravity CLI Features](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/features/): The Terminal Sandbox is a lightweight security isolation mechanism that protects your host system from potentially destructive file manipulations or unauthorized outbound network…
- [Migrating from Gemini CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/gcli-migration/): Convert your legacy configurations, import Gemini CLI extensions as native plugins, adapt custom skills paths, and reformat Model Context Protocol configurations.
- [Prompting & interaction](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/prompting/): Master primary interaction patterns, multiline composition workflows, session interruption controls, and terminal media pasting.
- [Reviewing artifacts](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/artifacts/): Audit generated code, review implementation proposals, attach line-level feedback comments, and verify visual media assets before applying edits to your local filesystem.
- [Managing conversations](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/conversations/): Resume prior development threads, scope active histories to local workspaces, and fork conversations to experiment with alternate architectures.
- [Choose an execution mode](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/modes/): Control whether Antigravity CLI pauses to ask before modifying files or executing commands during a session.
- [Headless mode](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/): Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
- [Background tasks & subagents](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/subagents/): Delegate slow builds, multi-file code generation, and research sweeps to parallel background agents while maintaining your active programming flow.
- [Sandbox](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/sandbox/): Enforce native operating system process isolation, manage execution containment boundaries, and protect your local workstation.
- [Permissions](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/permissions/): Secure your local workstation, restrict absolute file paths, configure custom allow/deny/ask policies, and manage interactive approvals.
- [Projects](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/projects/): Manage projects and organize conversation sessions in the Antigravity CLI.
- [Settings, rendering & keybindings](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/settings/): Configure persistent preferences, customize keyboard shortcuts, toggle terminal display buffers, and manage runtime CLI parameter overrides.
- [Vim editor mode](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/vim-editor-mode/): Edit prompts with modal Vim keybindings instead of the default flat text editor.
- [Managing AI Credits & Quotas](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/credits/): The Antigravity CLI integrates with your subscription to monitor and manage your AI Premium credits and usage quotas.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/mcp/): Antigravity supports the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io), an open standard that lets AI agents and editors securely connect to local developer…
- [Plugins & skills](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/plugins/): Extend agent capabilities, install third-party extension bundles, package custom workflow skills, and interface with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
- [Status line customization](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/statusline/): Define custom scripting configurations and format dynamic JSON state payloads to customize your TUI status line.
- [Terminal title customization](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/title/): Configure dynamic window titles, map custom scripting configurations, and format JSON state outputs to customize terminal headers.
- [Agents Command (/agents)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/agents/): Browse, select, and switch between custom agents, or monitor active and completed background subagents directly inside an interactive TUI panel.
- [Code Search Command (/codesearch)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/codesearch/): Interactively search the code in your workspace from inside the TUI, without leaving your session or interrupting the agent.
- [AI Credits Command (/credits)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/credits/): View and manage your AI Premium credits interactively.
- [Diff Command (/diff)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/diff/): View and review workspace changes, commit history, and agent turn diffs interactively within the TUI.
- [Permissions Command (/permissions)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/permissions/): Manage your fine-grained agent permission rules interactively within the TUI.
- [Resume Command (/resume)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/resume/): Browse, search, and resume past conversation threads, or recover your last session instantly from the command line.
- [Status Line Command (/statusline)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/statusline/): Toggle the TUI status line or configure a custom rendering command.
- [Window Title Command (/title)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/title/): Configure dynamic terminal window titles interactively.
- [Model Quotas (/usage)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/usage/): View your active model quota usage and refresh your configuration.
- [Voice Dictation (/voice)](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/voice/): The `/voice` command (alias `/record`) records audio from your microphone and streams real-time transcripts directly into the prompt box as you speak.
- [Best practices for Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/best-practices/): Master the workflows, prompt architectures, and local configuration choices to maximize agent velocity while maintaining robust control.
- [Troubleshooting](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/troubleshooting/): Diagnose and resolve common anomalies with installation PATHs, local self-updating locks, keyring access permissions, and SSH clipboard forwarding.
- [CLI reference](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/reference/): Scan scannable tables listing all TUI slash commands, default keyboard shortcuts, and JSON configuration parameters.
